title: Enable prepared task materialization with owned publication and recovery
outcome: Enable prepared task materialization with owned publication and recovery
acceptance: Explicit main-checkout materialization (`engram task-sync setup-materialize`, distinct from the opt-in `enable` setter) consumes the immutable setup intent and B1 selected raw candidate without reserialization or recapture, verifies repository/branch/marker/relevant index/setup/task basis, reports no-op redactor and note/activity/worktree omissions, and refuses restricted, secret or secret-ref task fields with bounded IDs/count/reason and no values before any new state or write.

It publishes only the declared setup edits and canonical .engram shared paths using retained operation-owned sources and no-clobber file-identity proof, preserves unowned equal or divergent state, supports exact repeat and interruption recovery at every publication boundary including setup replacement, and preserves unrelated private/index/branch/config/SQLite state; owned Windows tests verify concurrent lock loser zero writes, store-write independence, linked refusal and LF/index byte identity under autocrlf/global eol.

No disable/retire/replace command, sparse enrollment, Git commit/index/network/branch-policy mutation, TermAl relay or durable SQLite/projection change is introduced; replacement primitive obtains Fable/design concurrence before code and any durable-store change is presented to Greg before coding.

Task sync is optional and off by default for each project: before any new state or write, prepare, materialization, export and import read the Engram-owned per-project opt-in setting (w-4df5868f905a) and refuse for every caller with no write unless it is explicitly enabled; every caller means the supported CLI commands and the shared LocalWorkService preparation, export, import and materialization entrypoints, while pure format readers, B1's inert read, backup and migration stay independent; an absent, invalid or unreadable setting means not enabled; an operation already admitted under its journal finishes or recovers, but a new materialization from a completed setup intent needs current opt-in (Greg's correction relayed by Engram::Advisor, 2026-10-12 #1280).

completion.summary: Delivered explicit setup-materialize from selected immutable setup intent and raw prepared candidate, operation-owned no-clobber publication, exact repeat and admitted process-exit recovery after opt-out. Shared CLI/service opt-in guards fail closed before new state. Full gate PASS, complete Codex/Claude pair noMedium+, independent acceptance4/4pass. All4live storesready; clean release installed and master pushed. Three Low follow-ups filed. Logs-only evidence retention and worktree cleanup follow.
